label: Nametags
description: Shows your own nametag in third person and restyles every nametag's background, size and shadow.
settings_description: Settings for the Nametags gameplay mod. Restyles the label vanilla already draws over a player or named mob — the same labels, at the same moments, through the same walls — so it never shows a name the game would not. `tag_scale` tops out at 1.5 for that reason: a bigger label is legible farther, but it cannot appear anywhere vanilla's would not.

show_own.description: Whether your own nametag is drawn over your head in third person. Vanilla never draws it; on by default because that is the one thing players switch this mod on for.

hide_others.description: Whether other players' and named mobs' nametags are hidden. Armour stands are exempt: lobby holograms are stacks of named stands, and they are world text rather than nametags. Off by default — a name is how you tell a teammate from an enemy — and on for recording and for crowded lobbies.

tag_background.description: Alpha of the dark plate behind each name. 0.25 is vanilla's; 0 draws the text alone.

tag_scale.description: Size of every nametag as a multiple of vanilla's.

tag_shadow.description: Whether the name is drawn with Minecraft's text shadow, which keeps it legible against sky and snow. Vanilla draws it without one.
